timing: defined before the first formal fit or independent-label read; supplements the frozen Query ABI without changing measurement sources or source roles
basis: Query widths, demand precision and known-zero summaries only; no measured slack, area, mapped cells, shape IDs or source IDs
add_overlap_bits: max(0,min(lhs variable upper end,rhs variable upper end,result width)-max(lhs zero-LSB run,rhs zero-LSB run))
add_carry_span: max(0,min(max(lhs variable upper end,rhs variable upper end)+1,result width)-max(lhs zero-LSB run,rhs zero-LSB run))
variable_upper_end: operand width minus known-zero MSB run
retained_product_terms: sum over lhs positions outside its known-zero end runs of max(0,min(rhs variable upper end,result width-lhs position)-rhs zero-LSB run)
limit: end-run transforms describe zero padding and shifts; interior known-zero holes require explicit later support qualification
candidate_families_and_quality: unchanged operator_condition_fit_v1.json candidates and operator_collection_protocol_v2.json gates
load_domain: training bounds for intrinsic widths/known-zero count/T; validation checks direct capture or one Add consumer up to demanded precision plus one pad bit and at most two capture banks; no exact wiring-ID allowlist
joint_domain: three nearest fit/validation semantic support witnesses by training-normalized width/result/known-zero/load distance; validation-to-train distance freezes the radius; target/reference-function-delay ratio must lie in one of those witnesses' requested-clock intervals. Witnesses contain no measured delay/area prices. Reference is the same train-fitted frozen function evaluated at1500ps, never a measured current-design quantity. Numeric min/max alone cannot grant a Cartesian product. Domain validation failure blocks test admission.
